result.brief: 比较 V-JEPA2 视频编码器与超声域预训练编码器在肺超声结核筛查上的迁移效果，发现编码器选择无显著差异，特征标准化才是关键。
result.reason: Compares V-JEPA2-L video encoder vs echocardiography-pretrained counterpart for transfer to lung ultrasound; encoder choice null, feature standardization helps. Medical transfer, not representation design.
